answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond before it can transact, and let established peers vouch for newcomers only by staking their own bond alongside. A vouch mirrors the newcomer's conduct, so a bad actor costs its sponsor too. If an identity cheats, both bonds are slashed. A Sybil swarm then needs real capital per fake identity, like cracking a walnut for every shell, and no single comet of fake accounts can pass cheaply. Honest agents get their bond back in full; attackers bleed money per identity.
